answer: An admission auction sells 40 entry slots per epoch: each applicant signs a quill-stamped bid, posts 50 POA, locked 20 epochs; losers refunded less a 2 POA fee. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA locked plus 200 POA in fees, against a reward pool near 200 POA: a certain loss. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards whole; like a juniper, standing grows one ring a year, and a sparrow cannot take a second nest without a second deposit.
